title: Quarterly roadmap sync: Hosted API milestones and model catalog prioritization
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Objective: Produce a prioritized, deliverable quarterly roadmap that aligns Hosted API product milestones with Model Catalog improvements for Q2 2026. Scope covers: (1) model catalog curation and metadata (performance badges, cost estimates), (2) hosted API product changes to support model variants and rollout guardrails, and (3) OKR alignment with cost/latency/reliability targets. Deliverables: 1) A public-facing model catalog update plan, 2) Hosted API feature milestones (variant routing, default quantized variants, profiling pipeline), 3) Cross-functional rollout checklist and release timeline for staged model rollouts.
success_metrics: Median text generation latency (p50) for default tier reduced from 120ms to <=95ms
Platform unit token cost for top 10 endpoints reduced by >=12% through catalog and runtime changes
Model catalog pages show performance badges for 80% of listed models
95% of model rollouts use automated compatibility checks and fallbacks
acceptance_criteria: Draft roadmap published and reviewed by Eng/Design/Sales by 2026-03-20
Top 6 model candidates profiled and performance metadata available in staging catalog
Hosted API variant routing prototype merged to staging and demoed to PMs and infra on 2026-04-01
Risk and rollback procedures documented and included in release checklist
updates: 2026-02-26: Kickoff meeting with Eng, Design, Research. Agreed scope and initial prioritization framework (latency, cost, customer demand). Action: ENG to provide profiling infra ETA (owner: Priya Verma).

2026-03-02: Eng provided profiling baseline for 12 candidate models. Early signal: smaller quantized variants outperform baseline for common prompts by ~18% cost savings. Decision: include quantized variant promotion in roadmap.

2026-03-05: Design review — mockups for model catalog badges (latency badge, cost estimate, use-case tags) reviewed. Feedback: add contextual help and dataset provenance. Action: DES-118 to produce final assets.

2026-03-08: Risk review with Security and Compliance. Conclusion: model provenance metadata must be included for any catalog 'verified' badge. Security review not required for roadmap but will be required for individual rollouts.

2026-03-10: PM sync with Sales and Customer Success. Customers requested clearer guidance for choosing models for low-latency endpoints; include a 'recommended-for-low-latency' tag and quickstart snippets in docs.
2026-03-12: Updated draft roadmap attached; moved 'auto-fallback policy' to P0 for early rollout due to reliability concerns. Assigned ENG-2090 as implementation owner for routing policies.
risks: Profiling noise: sample prompts may not represent customer workloads leading to inaccurate cost/latency badges
Rollout complexity: introducing variant routing adds surface area for regression in SLOs if fallback policies are not robust
Dependency on infra work (ENG-2045) for stable profiling pipeline could slip and delay catalog updates
Customer confusion: more model metadata may increase choice paralysis unless we provide clear recommendations
